name: eICU Collaborative Research Database: Multi-Center Intensive Care EHR Benchmark
description: The eICU Collaborative Research Database is a multi-center critical care dataset released by Philips Healthcare and the MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology, published in Nature Scientific Data. The database comprises clinical records for over 200,000 patient stays admitted to intensive care units across 208 distinct hospitals throughout the United States between 2014 and 2015. Documenting vital signs, care plan documentation, severity of illness scores (APACHE IV), diagnosis information, treatment orders, and laboratory measurements recorded during telehealth ICU operations, eICU-CRD enables cross-hospital generalization studies, clinical risk modeling, and algorithmic fairness benchmarking across disparate healthcare systems.
